read_detection_method.method: All eight production modules and raw assumptions manually read. Balanced call parsing expands concrete object.get/is_true/is_false/has_value uses and exact input aliases. Two closed dynamic readers expand five required record fields and three eligible technique IDs. Nested crop/constraint/shared-equipment receivers are explicitly added; the generic common boolean helpers are expanded only at concrete native callsites. Static table rows are not treated as input aliases. This is a tailored audited ledger, not a general Rego parser.

dynamic_key_templates.key_domain: table-driven technique IDs from eligible application_techniques

blind_spots_corrected: Historical input scanner reports only direct input/object.get roots; actual aliased records, groups, nested material blocks and helper readers require whole-module dataflow.
object.get(application,[volumes_m3,t],0) resolves exact eligible table IDs rather than an inferred wildcard path.
required_record_fields resolves five actual record leaves; area/crops/land_use/soil and NAPV exception flags are consumed through additional code paths.
Shared-device generic conditions read application and separation, but each concrete used caller remains at its actual component; no false second readsite is added.
Per-parcel federal_state and district are actual unmanaged inputs absent from both canonical schema and all 25 proposals.
